Episode 224: Humiliation of Poison Castle (1)
"I'm not sure what you mean... are you saying I made the prisoners disappear?"

"Don't play dumb, you bastard! If not you, then who? The fact that there were Rune Candels in the lowermost prison was known only to you and me, and Gero and the jailers. But neither Gero, me, nor the collapsed jailers here would have released them, right?"
"Why not? There's no such thing as absolute in this world. Absolutely not, I too had such a casual thought and got my position stolen by my son."
Kelliac said with a calm face. Ragal took a brief moment to catch his breath as anger surged in him like a twisted gut.
"Hoo... I nearly killed you, you piece of filth. Fine, the situation has already occurred so we can't help it. Choose, will you go to the torture room nicely, or will you go after exploding?"
"In my opinion, you shouldn't be making a fuss at me right now, but go outside and personally look for the escaped prisoners with your subordinates. That is, if you really need the prisoners."
"You're pulling tricks again. If I rush to find the prisoners because I'm in a hurry, are you planning to run away this time?"
At those words, Kelliac let out a quiet chuckle.

"Why would I run away? I swore loyalty to Lord Jito myself to become a member of the Demon Realm. There is no place for me in the human world now. So why would I run away? Why would I have a reason to release the prisoners? You need to think a little more in your life."
Each word amplified Ragal's anger. Ragal barely held onto his sanity by exerting extreme patience.

'I can't... if I kill this bastard, there will definitely be problems. There's a reason Lord Jito entrusted him to me. Although I don't know what it is, he must have had no choice but to accept this human related to the witch. So I absolutely cannot kill him. Calm down, Ragal...!'
However, unfortunately, Kelliac had no intention of easing Ragal's mind.
"Oh, you thought I would run because I'm scared? Hmm, Ragal, you don't seem to be a big threat to me. Don't waste your energy meaninglessly and go find the prisoners."
Tick-! The thin thread of sanity snapped. Ragal glared at Kelliac with eyes soaked in bloodlust.
"I was going to finish you off after some torture... but you must die. I'll take care of the aftermath."
Whoosh...!
As soon as Ragal finished his words, poisonous fog spread out instantly. The fog quickly filled the underground prison, but that was just what could be seen.
Ragal's poisonous fog had already filled the vast poison zone. The fog, as if it had a life of its own, could discern those who weren't under Ragal's command and horrifically dissolve them.

Screams of agony from the demons from other regions who came to seek the Poisoned Lands echoed through the city. Demons who came to meet friends or lovers, merchants, and even passersby were all meeting death.
Yet, Kelliac, who was facing the most intense poison right in front of Ragal, still wore a smile.
"Poison... they say it threatened my ancestor, who was regarded as the strongest in history. But unlike my ancestors, I have nothing to protect."
Kelliac's staff was colored with flames. The scene of the poison swirling and being sucked into the staff continued.
"On the contrary, now it's you who needs to protect. You've longed for a long time to become the Demon King, to receive the title of Mara... You can't let everything turn to ashes overnight."
Tsahaak-!

The flame attached to the staff exploded, and in an instant, it brought down the underground prison. Ragal was flung against the wall, and by the time he opened his eyes again, Kelliac had already broken through the ceiling and gone outside the castle.
On his back were wings made of fire.
The demons of the city were momentarily confused at the sight. It was time for the artificial sun to be off, but suddenly the sky brightened, leading them to mistake Kelliac for the artificial sun.
However, what filled the entire sky was not the pale light of the artificial sun, but the flaming red flames.
Ragal's poison could not assault Kelliac through the heat. Kelliac looked down leisurely at Ragal, and all that he possessed.
Then he began to fire off the magic that symbolized him without chanting a spell.
Spatial explosion, a spell that causes everything in sight to explode with just a will.
The topmost part of the Poisoned Castle was the first to be demolished. From the guards to the generals who hastily ran out, none could realize the moment of their death and met their end.
Bang, bang, with every explosive sound, someone died or somewhere collapsed. Ragal, startled by the unexpected situation, blurted out an exclamation and emitted poison.
"This bastard...! Dare to look down on me, Ragal? Let's see how long you can do that, you will be writhing in pain that you can't even imagine!"
Ragal spread his wings and flew up to the sky. He intended to thrust the poison condensed in his hand into Kelliac's heart.
However, Ragal's wing exploded due to the spatial explosion even before he rose ten meters.
Although the wing was immediately regenerated, the result was the same when he flew again. He was shot down as soon as he took off, not even able to touch Kelliac.
Even when he attempted a long-range attack, it was the same. All the poison of the Poisoned Lands became Ragal's power, but the fire barrier that Kelliac spread was stronger.
"Hopefully, you'll face reality before the castle is completely destroyed. Don't resist too vigorously, it's not as easy to control my power as it used to be."

Following the continued spatial explosion, the left side of the castle feebly collapsed. Even while Ragal momentarily turned to look at the destroyed castle, the center of the city closest to the castle exploded, and flames began to spread.
"Lord Ragal! Please save us...!"
"Lord Ragal!"
Injured demons cried out from all over the castle. Even the high-ranking demon generals were no different from ordinary soldiers, emitting miserable cries, and their wounds were not regenerating.
This was because the speed at which the flame burned skin and bone exceeded their regenerative ability. And Ragal realized that even a spark that had just attached to him was not going out.
Even Ragal, the Demon King's super-regeneration, could not overcome Kelliac's fire.
'Although I'm exhausted due to the battle with Elona... This doesn't make sense. Isn't this worse than that human...!'
Creation or the extremity.

The limit known to mortals, whether in the demon world or in the human world, is the same despite the different terms. And Ragal, having fought with Elona, had never felt as overwhelmed as he was now.

"You might feel that I'm stronger than our ancestor. I don't know about that, Ragal. But one thing is certain. If it wasn't for the hostages, you wouldn't have touched a single hair of our ancestor. Don't underestimate Zifel, even the strongest man I know didn't."
The pleas of his subordinates to save them continued. Ragal, sweating profusely, tried to attack again, but the result was just another part of his body exploding due to the spatial explosion.
Ragal had no choice but to attempt a final struggle, summoning all the poison that had covered the entire Poisoned Lands to him.
However, just as Ragal was about to release the poison he had gathered with great effort, Kelliac, who had descended to the ground, pierced his neck with his staff.
"You're nothing more than a bug compared to that man."
Thunk-!

The staff, like a stake, was driven into the ground, pinning Ragal's neck. Ragal fell to his knees, his upper body toppled backward in a strange posture. What he saw was not Kelliac, but the burning Poisoned Castle behind him.
"Khahak... Keuk!"
"Demon's trait is quite convenient. Even with a hole through the neck and stuck to the ground, they're still breathing. How is it, want to end your life this way?"

"Think carefully, I'm giving you an opportunity right now. Depending on how you respond, Ragal Fun and the Poisoned Lands will either disappear from the demon world today... or gain more power than before."
"Kuh, Kuaaak...!"
When Kelliac twisted his staff, Ragal, like his subordinates, twisted his body screaming. Blood tears poured from both eyes, and his body trembled with bone-chilling pain.

"Ah, I guess you won't be able to speak in this state. As I said before, it's hard to control my power, I'm still not fully adapted. I'll give you 10 seconds. If you don't blink for 10 seconds, I'll take it as you want to live. But if you blink even once, you'll turn into ashes."
How can I not blink when I'm in so much pain, you crazy...!
Ragal wanted to shout like that, but he couldn't make a sound. All he could do was endure for 10 seconds to survive.
Those 10 seconds were undoubtedly the longest 10 seconds in Ragal Fun's long life.
"Keheheeek!"
When Kelliac pulled out his staff, Ragal bent his body forward, which had been fixed, and held his neck with both hands. Saliva, blood, and tears were dripping from every hole in his face.
"You endured well. And you've now adopted a very suitable position to face me."
Ragal naturally found himself bowing his body and kneeling.

He had no energy to argue or resist. Ragal barely lifted his head to look up at Kelliac. The man who was just a strange human entrusted by Zito until a little while ago, now had a face as terrifying as Zito.
"Why... are you doing this to me...?"
"You're asking a strange question. I intended to stay quiet, Ragal. But didn't you start an unnecessary fight despite my warning?"
"You intended to do this from the start... now that you've beaten me, you plan to take my place and become the owner of the Poisoned Castle."

"Why would I, who was the ruler of Zifel, want such a shabby castle stuck underground? Besides, even though I became a demon world military, I'm not a demon, so it would be strange for me to become a demon king."
"Huh, your behavior right now is the strangest..."
"Get up. It seems there aren't many of your subordinates who have properly witnessed your ugly defeat, so it would be good to heal your wounds quickly. Don't worry, the witnesses will die soon."
The voices of his subordinates who had been crying out for Ragal to save them gradually faded.
As Kelliac waved his staff, the flames on Ragal's body began to subside. Ragal could only start recovering after all the fires were extinguished.
"For now, let's consider that I lost this fight to you. It would be better to finish the rest of the story back at the castle."
